validity.recommendation: Reconcile with P3620 (Israel-Egypt Onshore Gas Pipeline) - almost certainly the same physical pipe; likely merge P7864 into P3620 (or keep one, relabel), and settle the status conflict (P3620=construction vs P7864=proposed).
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: solidly real. The Nitzana pipeline is documented by many independent outlets covering the 16-17 Sept 2025 Chevron / Israel Natural Gas Lines (INGL) construction agreement: JPT/SPE, ENR, Rigzone, Times of Israel, MEES (setback piece dated 30 May 2025), NE Global, OilPrice, Offshore Magazine. Not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: correct - onshore gas transmission trunk (INGL lays ~65 km of 36-in line from Ramat Hovav to the Nitzana border crossing; Chevron builds a compressor station at Ramat Hovav). SPECS all corroborated by >=2 independent sources: length 65 km (JPT/INGL 'roughly 65 km'; MEES/NE Global cite 36-in x 67-km - minor 65 vs 67 spread, GEM's 65 defensible), diameter 36 in (ENR, MEES, NE Global), capacity 600 MMcf/d = ~6 bcm/yr (JPT, ENR, MEES, Rigzone), cost USD 610M (ENR, Times of Israel, JPT, OilPrice), commissioning 2028 (all). DUPLICATE (the concern): roster row P3620 'Israel-Egypt Onshore Gas Pipeline' has start=Ramat Hovav, length=65.0 km, capacity=6.0 (bcm/yr = ~600 MMcf/d) - identical origin, identical length, identical throughput to the Nitzana pipeline, which IS the Israel-Egypt onshore line from Ramat Hovav. Near-certainly the same physical pipe entered twice, with a status conflict (P3620=construction, P7864=proposed). Recommend a human de-dup/merge. NOTE also ProposalYear: GEM records 2025-08, but MEES says the pipeline was 'initially announced in 2023' - the 2025-08 date reflects the Leviathan supply deal, not first proposal; minor caveat, not staged as a change.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Recorded status 'proposed' is still right. Newest dated evidence: the 16-17 Sept 2025 Chevron/INGL agreement to 'kickstart construction' with construction expected in Q4 2025 and a ~3-year build to 2028 commissioning (JPT 2025-09-16, ENR, Rigzone 2025-09-17, Times of Israel). This is a construction sanction/greenlight, NOT confirmed physical construction start - no independent report of groundbreaking found. MEES (30 May 2025) documented volume-allocation and cost disputes pushing back startup, and NE Global still calls it the 'planned' pipeline. Proposal is <2y old, so dormancy rules do not apply - not stale. Keep 'proposed'; escalate to 'construction' only when a dated groundbreaking/pipe-laying report is verified. NOTE the P3620 conflict flagged in validity: P3620 (the same pipe) is already carried as 'construction' - the two rows must be reconciled to one status.

summary: Nitzana Pipeline is real and correctly classified (65 km / 36-in / 600 MMcf/d / $610M gas transmission, Ramat Hovav->Nitzana border, INGL+Chevron), but is a near-certain DUPLICATE of P3620 (Israel-Egypt Onshore Gas Pipeline: same Ramat Hovav origin, 65 km, ~6 bcm/yr); status 'proposed' confirmed (Sept 2025 greenlight, no verified groundbreaking).
